name: patternlike-app
description: Pattern-Like Astrology App monorepo — Cloudflare-first, Swiss Ephemeris calculation authority

scripts.//build: @patternlike/web builds BEFORE @patternlike/api: the api build is a production dry-run deploy, and [env.production.assets] reads apps/web/dist, which must already exist.
scripts.test: npm run test -w @patternlike/shared -w @patternlike/reading-engine -w @patternlike/calc-stub -w @patternlike/api -w @patternlike/web && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: python contracts/validate_schemas.py && python contracts/m0/smoke_check.py && python contracts/smoke_check.py
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build -w @patternlike/web && npm run deploy -w @patternlike/api
